summary.text: Pete Aguilar is the Democratic incumbent for California's 33rd Congressional District, which he has represented since 2015. A former Redlands mayor and local-government staffer, he has chaired the House Democratic Caucus since 2023 and serves on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Pete Aguilar was born in Fontana, California, in 1979.

According to his official biography, his family has lived in the community for four generations, and he started his first job at age twelve working with his grandfather at the San Bernardino County Courthouse cafeteria.

He graduated from Yucaipa High School and earned bachelor's degrees in government and business administration from the University of Redlands in 2001, putting himself through college with student loans and federal grants.
Aguilar worked as a business owner and as an executive of a community credit union, then as Deputy Director and later Interim Director of the Inland Empire Regional Office of the California governor.
He was appointed to the Redlands City Council in 2006 and served until 2014, and was Mayor of Redlands from 2010 to 2014.
Aguilar was elected to the U.S. House in 2014, took office in 2015, and was most recently re-elected in 2024.
He serves on the House Appropriations Committee and is a member of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus and the New Democrat Coalition.
House Democrats elected him caucus chairman for the 118th Congress on November 30, 2022, and re-elected him unopposed for the 119th Congress on November 19, 2024.
His official biography says he lives in Redlands with his wife, Alisha, and their two sons.
